text_block_list.text:
Lately, the days have been packed with 
races and training, leaving no room to let 
my guard down. Just then...
(Ring ring...)

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text:
"Ah, Trainer! If you're free tomorrow, 
well――"

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text: "Why don't we go on a picnic!"

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text:
Mmm... What a lovely breeze. It's the 
perfect weather for a picnic!

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text:
No, no! I'm glad I could come too! 
Besides—
Oh? Could you be... Light Hello?

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text:
It's my former Trainer! Wah! It's been so 
long!

text_block_list.name: Former Dedicated Trainer
text_block_list.text:
I saw your achievements in the magazine. I 
hear you're running around as an event 
producer now?

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text:
Yes! I still have plenty of room to 
grow... but I'm doing my best!

text_block_list.name: Former Dedicated Trainer
text_block_list.text:
That hardworking nature of yours hasn't 
changed a bit. Back then, you were 
always――

text_block_list.name: Former Dedicated Trainer
text_block_list.text:
She worked relentlessly on my training 
plan. Even when the results didn't show in 
races, she kept fighting on.

text_block_list.name: Former Dedicated Trainer
text_block_list.text:
Still... I couldn't live up to those 
efforts. Nor could I bring her to a 
shining stage. And yet—

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text:
Thank you for everything, Trainer-san. 
Every day was so much fun... It was such a 
happy academy life!

text_block_list.name: Former Dedicated Trainer
text_block_list.text:
When I saw that smile, I thought to 
myself... Could I have done even more for 
her? ...I wanted to do so much more.

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text: Trainer-san...

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text:
...I'm truly grateful. Those days made me 
who I am today.

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text:
I want to create a stage where Umamusume 
can shine. Because it's those cherished 
days that support this dream of mine.

text_block_list.name: Former Dedicated Trainer
text_block_list.text:
Light Hello... thank you. Make sure you 
make that dream come true, okay? I'm 
rooting for you.

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text:
To think she cared that much... 
............I should have relied on her 
more, too.

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text:
Relying on someone doesn't just mean 
following their orders. Now that I've met 
you, I finally understand that.

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text:
Like having someone tag along when taking 
a breather, or letting them see an 
embarrassing side of you.

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text:
You were the one who taught me that it's 
important to rely on others like this 
sometimes.

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text:
...Which is why! I invited you out for a 
picnic today!

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text:
Haven't you been exhausted lately? The 
battles in our races have been getting 
more intense, after all.

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text:
At times like this! Taking a breather is 
what's most important, right?

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text:
Alright then, let's start with a massage 
to soothe all that physical fatigue!

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text:
All right, that took care of the shoulder 
stiffness. Next, let's fill our bellies 
and hearts with lunch♪

Even after that, Light Hello's refreshing 
session continued...
—Trai... ner... Trai...

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text: Fufu♪ . You were sleeping so soundly.

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text:
No, no. I'm just glad you found it 
soothing enough to sleep soundly.

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text:
Whenever you feel tired again, please just 
say the word, okay? I'll gladly keep you 
company anytime.

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text:
I think there will be plenty of times…… 
where I'll be relying on you from now on, 
after all!
